summary: The proposed patch addresses the UnboundLocalError by raising a NotImplementedError for non-number arguments, but it may not fully resolve all edge cases and could be improved for clarity.

issues.description: The patch raises NotImplementedError for non-number arguments, which might not be the best solution for all cases. It does not handle the root cause of the UnboundLocalError and could lead to other similar issues if not addressed properly.
The patch adds repetitive code for raising NotImplementedError. This could be refactored to improve readability and maintainability.
